author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: gamma_max=0.70 (k=45)
abstract: Further micro-reduction of residualization (gamma_max=0.70) with tau=0.95 whitening and k=45 cosine balanced kNN. Acceptance only if mean increases or label metrics improve without mixing loss.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from praxis.dual_whitened_adaptpc import run_pipeline
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return run_pipeline(adata,
                        n_pcs_emb=64, alpha=0.95,
                        n_pcs_graph=50, gamma_max=0.70, lam=0.9, l2=1e-3,
                        k_total=45, metric='cosine')
